blocks.raw: # Profile: Current User Group

User Groups in Capillary represent collections of users (customers or contributors) grouped together for participating in group-based loyalty programs or business engagements, particularly useful for B2B and B2C loyalty scenarios.
blocks.text: User Groups in Capillary represent collections of users (customers or contributors) grouped together for participating in group-based loyalty programs or business engagements, particularly useful for B2B and B2C loyalty scenarios.

blocks.raw: This profile allows you to write conditions based on the properties of the user group that is currently involved in the activity.
blocks.text: This profile allows you to write conditions based on the properties of the user group that is currently involved in the activity.
